limitations: Platform skips are explicitly excluded from pass totals.
R4 remains unconfirmed on RN 0.86; its once-only control passes on both platforms.
TSan tests an exact extracted production DrawToken with a stub canvas on macOS, not the full UIKit app.
R6 uses Android surface teardown and Hermes GC; no iOS surface teardown or RSS measurement is claimed.
No Release build, physical-device run, long-session memory profile or remote GitHub Actions execution is claimed.
Unsafe request-key tombstones intentionally live until explicit release or runtime destruction. This is not distributed exactly-once.

intermediate_failures.ios-review.json: The added late-write fixture used a timer and could coalesce its first chunk; final test gates completion explicitly through /complete.
intermediate_failures.android-retention.json: The test producer retained every allocated buffer in a strong Kotlin map; final test uses the production pre-aborted fetch allocator and releases its JS owner before GC.
